title: Contents
summary: The page's table of contents («Оглавление»): the sections of the page as in-page links, the current one marked while the page scrolls. Four views from one list -- a side column, a compact button with the reading progress, strokes at the edge, a sticky row of anchor tabs -- and auto, the column on a wide screen and the compact button on a narrow one. It collects the headings itself or takes the items a server printed, and works as plain links without the script.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

layout.description: How the contents are laid out (the axis of sf-dropdown and sf-empty-state: view is a reserved name, §3.1). column: a side list with the current section's bar; compact: one button showing the current section and the reading progress, opening the list; rail: short strokes at the edge, the names on hover and focus, and on a tap where nothing hovers; bar: a sticky row of anchor tabs, for long forms, what does not fit in «Ещё (n)» (overflow); auto: column at and above the collapse step, compact below it (a media rule, so the first paint is right without the script). Below md (44rem) the compact view's list opens as a bottom sheet. For an article on a phone, a column with sticky="false" at the top of the text is the contents once, in place

collapse.description: With layout auto: the Framework breakpoint (sm 32rem, md 44rem, lg 60rem, xl 72rem) below which the column turns compact

target.description: A CSS selector of the content whose headings make the contents, when no items are given; empty: the page's main, else its body. The headings found get an id when they have none

levels.description: The heading levels collected from the target: one level (2) or a range (2-3). A deeper level is indented

size.description: The ladder rung of the text and of the compact view's controls

sticky.description: Every layout stays in view while the page scrolls (position sticky, below --sf-contents-inset-block-start): the column, the rail, the bar, and the compact button, which takes the page surface as its backing so nothing shows through it

line.description: Who draws the line the entries stand on, in the column and the bar (owner decision C95 point 1, CT-01): own (the default) -- the element draws its 1 px line; edge -- the host's divider is the line: the element draws none and the current section's 2 px mark lies on its inline-start edge (the bar: its bottom edge), over the divider's pixel, so the host puts it flush against its divider (an inset shadow or a border on the column, the element its first child); none -- no line and no mark, the current section is its ink and weight alone. The text's distance from the line is --sf-contents-inset-inline

expand.description: Which deeper entries the column and the compact list show (owner decision C95 point 3, CT-11): all (the default) every level; current only the deeper entries of the current branch -- the top-level section being read and the entries under it -- the other branches folded to their top entry, as a long documentation page needs. The rail and the bar show every entry

overflow.description: With layout bar, what the row does with sections that do not fit: more (the default) puts them whole into a trailing «Ещё (n)» menu in their order, the current one always staying in the row, as sf-tabs does (owner decision C54); scroll lets the row scroll sideways without a scrollbar, as before 1.5.0 (journal behaviour-contents-bar-overflow-more)

hash.description: When the address shows the current section, with history.replaceState, so no history entry is added: choose (the default) writes #id when a section is chosen; scroll also when the page is scrolled to one; false never. Before 1.5.0 this was a boolean and on meant scroll; true and an empty attribute now read as choose (journal behaviour-contents-hash-choose)

label.description: The heading of the list and the navigation's accessible name; «На этой странице» / «On this page» in the page language when not set

heading-level.description: The outline level of the list's heading (role heading, aria-level) in the column, where it is shown; the navigation is named by it in every layout

items.description: The sections, [{id, text, level?, count?, status?}], when a server knows them: the element then collects nothing and spies on the elements with these ids. level is the heading level (2 when not given). count (a number above 0) and status (error, warning or success) put a badge on the entry's line, sized by its text (sf-badge line="text"), and say it in the entry's name («Контакты: 2 ошибки»); a section marked error is chosen to its first invalid field, not its heading (owner decision C95 point 6, CT-07). Links written inside carry them as data-count and data-status

refresh.summary: Collects the headings of the target again (vocabulary refresh): for a page whose content changed after the contents drew

toggle.summary: Opens the compact view's list when it is closed and closes it when it is open; refused while the layout is not compact

sf-contents-change.summary: The current section changed, by scrolling or by a section chosen: a fact, sent as sf-contents-change, not when the element first finds it

forbidden_client_responsibilities: styling a site's own contents list

keyboard: Tab reaches each section's link in order
Enter on a link scrolls to its section and moves focus there
Enter or Space on the compact button opens the list; Escape closes it and gives focus back to the button
accessibility.focus: A chosen section takes focus without scrolling again (tabindex -1 when it has none), as an in-page link does natively.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-contents for the table of contents of one long page: documentation, help, articles, long settings forms.
do_not: Do not use it for navigation between pages; that is sf-menu
Do not build a contents list of your own with a scroll listener
Do not put a second <nav> around it; the element is the navigation landmark
